bends.note: 30 ft north leg (printed LOCK) turns into the 60 ft south-east leg at the E 8th junction
north-south leg turns south-east (diagonal leg toward sheet 135) at E 7th

ends.note: ends at the north-west edge of the concrete viaduct band

notes: Broadway centre from block lines x~665/895 (two water pipes at ~757 and ~812). E Court: 70' printed at Broadway (block lines 639/875), 66' further east; it runs east-south-east, centre roughly y 783 at x 1300, 944 at x 2000, 1147 at x 2800, 1260 at x 3150 (north side partly only sheet-149 outline; approximate). Lockport/E Court is approximate: Lockport appears only as the sheet-140 outline in the top-left corner; point placed 124 px west of Broadway/Court as measured on sheet 140 (the outline here would put it ~120 px further west). Spring St (printed 'SPRING', ~24 ft) enters Court from the north (sheet-149 outline). Reedy St printed 'REEDY (CLEVELAND)', 60' at Court; its north continuation is Deer Creek R'd (printed), so Reedy/Court is a cross; Reedy slants slightly (centre ~2905 at y 1400, ~2790 at y 2500); approximate (+/-20 px). Eggleston Av: its centreline is estimated from the block faces on its SW side and the 48" pipe in it (railroad sidings fill its NE side), so Broadway/Eggleston, Eggleston/9th and Eggleston/Bedinger are approximate (+/-25 px). E 9th is ~46 ft west of Broadway (centre 1906) but only ~20 ft east of it (centre 1924, block lines 1892/1958): point is the mean. Bedinger (printed 'BEDINGER', ~30 ft, block lines 2464/2566) runs from Broadway to Eggleston beside the Chatfield Power buildings. E 8th: block lines ~3020/3230 east of Broadway, 66'; widens to 82' near the viaduct. The 'CONCRETE VIADUCT' band runs SW-NE across the lower right (from Culvert/8th toward the upper right); E 8th passes it and its continuation reaches Lock at the right edge (pipes 6" and 40"); no at-grade Eggleston/8th crossing is drawn (grade-separated), so none recorded. Lock/E 8th: Lock 30' (x~3416-3518) from the north, E 8th (50', centre ~3173) from the west, Lock continues SE as a 60 ft street. Whetstone Alley enters Broadway only from the west (sheet-134 outline, ~12 ft, lines 3724/3767). Culvert/7th: centroid of the three centreline crossings (N leg x~2263, 7th y~4122, SE leg through (2353,4147)).
